Let me analyze this question carefully.

The question asks about the first American to travel faster than the speed of sound. This is a well-documented historical event.

Chuck Yeager broke the sound barrier on October 14, 1947, flying the Bell X-1 aircraft at Mach 1.07. This made him the first person (not just American) to exceed the speed of sound in level flight.

Scott Crossfield was indeed a notable test pilot who later became the first person to fly at Mach 2 (twice the speed of sound) in 1953, but he was not the first to break the sound barrier.
